archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST mixed with ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY

rules: H1 must be fluid (clamp) up to text-6xl or text-7xl, tracking-tighter. Never use standard bold; use font-black.
Inputs, loaders, and metadata must use JetBrains Mono, uppercase tracking-widest for labels.
The 'Anti-Default Rule': Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.

colors.strategy: Cinematic Director's Desk. Pitch black foundation with blazing Studio Orange accents for actions.
rules: DO NOT use generic purple-on-white 'AI' themes.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds over images. Use bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl.
Studio Orange (#FF4500) is ONLY for the primary generation action and active states (like 'ON AIR').

visual_enhancers.lighting: Cinematic. Use the provided beam of light image as a fixed background plate with mix-blend-screen and opacity-20.
visual_enhancers.textures: MANDATORY: Add a fixed SVG noise overlay (pointer-events-none, opacity-5) over the entire application.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10. No heavy box-shadows. Use subtle inner glows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: High opacity (bg-black/60) with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) and 1px border-white/10 for the video player and sticky nav.

layouts.global: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 to p-24. Never cramp elements.
layouts.hero: Fullscreen cinematic narrative. Massive Cabinet Grotesk H1 centered or left-aligned. Below it, the primary prompt input field. It must be HUGE (text-2xl or text-3xl JetBrains Mono), max-w-4xl. No standard input styling—use a raw input with bg-white/5, backdrop-blur, bottom border, and focus:border-primary glow.
layouts.generation_state: Immersive overlay. Do not use standard spinners. Use a GSAP-driven typographic loading sequence (e.g., 'Writing Script...', 'Rendering Frames...') in JetBrains Mono.
layouts.video_player: Cinematic Presentation Player. 16:9 ratio, wrapped in crystal glassmorphism. DO NOT use native <video> controls. Custom UI: progress bar, play/pause, timeline dots for slides. Slides auto-advance crossfading via GSAP. Audio plays in background.
layouts.gallery_bento: Mode A 'Tetris' Grid for generated videos. Asymmetrical cards showing video thumbnails. Some span 2 rows/cols, others 1. gap-8.
layouts.marketing_steps: Narrative scroll sequence for 'How it Works'. Chapters fade in as user scrolls.

gsap_rules: Hero Reveal: Staggered characters/words fade up (y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1, duration: 1) on load.
Input Focus: GSAP animation to slightly scale up the input wrapper (scale: 1.02) and intensify border glow when user focuses.
Scroll: Use ScrollTrigger to fade and slide up marketing sections as they enter the viewport.
Video Player Scrubber: GSAP ticker to smoothly update the custom progress bar in sync with audio.
Slide Transition: GSAP crossfade (opacity) for slide images.

components_blueprint.prompt_input: The absolute star of the page. Massive text input/textarea. HTML/Tailwind input with bg-white/5, text-2xl JetBrains Mono, placeholder-white/30, border border-white/10, rounded-xl, p-8, focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(255,69,0,0.1)].
components_blueprint.video_player: Custom DOM layout. Absolute positioned slide images (opacity-0 by default, active is opacity-1). Custom absolute positioned scrubber at the bottom.
components_blueprint.hackathon_badge: Subtle, fixed bottom-right badge or integrated in footer. Text: 'Built for WeMakeDevs x AWS Hackathon'. Use a subtle AWS logo reference.

hero_background.description: Cinematic light beam penetrating smoke. Use as a background plate with mix-blend-screen and low opacity.

gallery_placeholders.description: Abstract amber curves on black. Use as placeholder thumbnails for generated presentations in the library.

accessibility: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='prompt-input'`).
Normal Text (below 18px): Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background.
Focus States: Must have HIGHER contrast than default state.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React.js (JavaScript, NOT TypeScript) application using Tailwind CSS.
Install and use `gsap` for all animations.
Do NOT use HTML `<video>` element with default controls. Build a custom DOM layout for the player.
Use Shadcn UI primarily for complex logic components (Dialogs, Toasts), but style them heavily to match the dark cinematic theme. Do not use generic Shadcn cards.
Ensure all fonts are imported into the root CSS/HTML as specified.
Follow the UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT rigorously.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
